full_judgment: 7. The real cause of the incident appears clearly from the questions put by the defence to PW 1. The defence case is that the boro field in question belongs to four brothers, such as Abdul Hamid (father of appellant's-Siddique Munshi), Taber Uddin, Rashid and Danesh but that the complainant's party (deceased Idris and his brother PW 1) also claimed it, that over this land the accused persons had instituted two criminal proceedings, one under section 107, and the other under section 144, of the CrPC and further that a GD Entry had been made with the Police against appellant-Idris Fakir. PW 1 denied having any knowledge about these cases, nor any paper in connection with those cases was produced by the defence. But that there was a dispute over possession of the boro land between the parties is found to have been clearly proved. And when the dead body of Lalmia was also found in or near about the boro land it is clear that the incident took place over the possession of the land. PW 1 has said that the land belongs to his brother who had grown the paddy therein. It has been suggested by the defence to him that he was among the persons who had raided the house of Lalmia but the suggestion has been denied outright. This is in substance the whole evidence of PW 1.
